title.en: Estimated planetary Kp is 1.00 (quiet) at 08:00 UTC on 7 October 2026.
title.zh: 2026 年 10 月 7 日 08:00 UTC，估計行星 Kp 為 1.00（平靜）。

summary.en: Latest reliable hour-start estimated Kp is 1.00 (1Z) at 08:00 UTC on 7 October 2026. The 08 hour is complete (60 samples through 08:59; hour-start 1.00/1Z, hour-end 1.00/1Z). Last-180 maximum is 1.00 (first at 2026-10-07T07:34:00Z; label 1Z). Published-window maximum is 1.33 (first at 2026-10-07T05:04:00Z; label 1P). Window starts 2026-10-07T04:00:00Z (358 samples). Window estimated_kp reached 1.33. The 09 UTC hour is incomplete (58 samples through 09:57).

evidence.limitations: Values are estimated Kp at 1-minute cadence and can be revised. The card uses the latest hour that has a full 60 samples; the following hour may still be incomplete.
evidence.method: NOAA SWPC planetary_k_index_1m.json. Main card is the hour-start estimated_kp of the latest complete hour. last-180 and published-window maxima are the first occurrence of the maximum estimated_kp in each window.
